name: sonic-privacy-pool
description: Privacy-focused dApp for anonymous token transfers on Sonic blockchain

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:contracts && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:circuits
scripts.build: npm run contracts:compile && npm run circuits:compile && npm run frontend:build
scripts.contracts:deploy:testnet: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network sonic-testnet
scripts.contracts:deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network sonic-mainnet
scripts.contracts:verify: cd contracts && npx hardhat verify --network sonic-testnet
scripts.test: npm run contracts:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.lint: npm run contracts:lint && npm run frontend:lint

author: Sonic Privacy Pool Team
